records.name: Review of Economic Analysis
records.publisher: International Centre for Economic Analysis; hosted by University of Waterloo Library
records.scope_notes: General-interest economics: original theoretical or empirical work, including existing-data policy studies and economic methodology. An economic contribution is necessary; generic AI or health articles do not automatically fit.

route.conditions: No submission or publication fees; original work in English. General-interest scope is not an acceptance guarantee.
route.other_mandatory_costs: none stated in the explicit no-submission/no-publication-fee policy

fee_evidence.note: Journal explicitly states that it does not charge submission or publication fees.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in discovery; independent ranking review required.

records.name: Erasmus Journal for Philosophy and Economics
records.publisher: Erasmus Institute for Philosophy and Economics, Erasmus University Rotterdam
records.scope_notes: Methodology, history, ethics and interdisciplinary relations of economics; critical surveys and arguments on incentives or research institutions may fit. Research articles are peer reviewed; book reviews, interviews and thesis summaries have different editorial status. Assess manuscript-level compatibility with the journal's AI policy.

route.conditions: Official About page explicitly says no submission fee and no APC or other publication fee. Articles normally 4,000–8,000 words including references; critical surveys are eligible.
route.other_mandatory_costs: none stated in the no-author-charges policy

fee_evidence.note: Official About page states no submission fees and no article-processing or other publication fee.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in discovery; independent ranking review required.

ai_policy.summary: AI use beyond grammar/readability copy editing must be disclosed. Journal will not consider submissions whose text is substantially written by AI; arguments and prose must be substantially the human author's own.

records.name: Economics and Business Letters
records.publisher: Oviedo University Press, University of Oviedo
records.scope_notes: Short theoretical or empirical economics/business letters and policy discussion; 2,500-word limit excluding specified elements. Official homepage says new submissions are closed from 19 October 2026 until further notice.

route.conditions: No submission, publication or article-processing charges under official author instructions. Fee-free policy remains documented, but the journal is currently unavailable for new submissions.
route.other_mandatory_costs: none stated in the explicit no-fees policy

fee_evidence.note: Author instructions answer no to submission/publication fees and APCs.
Homepage states new submissions are not accepted from 19 October 2026 until further notice.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in discovery; independent ranking review required.

submission_status_evidence.note: Closed to new submissions effective 2026-10-19 until further notice.

records.name: EKOIST Journal of Econometrics and Statistics
records.scope_notes: Quantitative economics and applications of econometric/statistical methods to measurement, prediction, testing and policy analysis. Economic content is emphasized; reusable and replicable methods fit. English and Turkish accepted.

route.conditions: Istanbul University covers all expenses; official price policy says no fee from authors or institutions under any name.
route.other_mandatory_costs: none; official price policy excludes fees under any name

fee_evidence.note: University covers all expenses; processing/publication are free, with no submission fees or APCs.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in discovery; independent ranking review required.

records.name: Journal of Mechanism and Institution Design
records.publisher: Society for the Promotion of Mechanism and Institution Design
records.scope_notes: Mechanism and institution design across economic, financial, political and social systems. Theory, empirical analysis and computation are eligible; results must be replicable and underlying data available to the journal. Suitable for incentives/allocation studies with a substantive design contribution.

route.conditions: Community-sponsored journal; official ethics statement excludes manuscript-processing/publication fees and says sponsor donations cover associated charges. Author guide has no page limit. Conference fees on the same domain are separate from journal submission.
route.other_mandatory_costs: none stated; no required journal membership identified

fee_evidence.note: Official statement excludes manuscript-processing and publication fees; sponsor donations cover associated charges.
Homepage identifies publication as free and journal as open-access and nonprofit.

records.name: Comparative Economic Studies
records.publisher: Palgrave Macmillan / Springer Nature for the Association for Comparative Economic Studies
records.scope_notes: Comparative political economy and economic systems; international or single-country studies of institutions, technology, demography, structural change and policy. Existing-data and theoretical institutional analyses can fit.

route.conditions: Choose standard subscription publishing with no APC. Instructions explicitly exclude submission charges. Print colour is an optional paid extra; select greyscale where acceptable. Paid immediate OA and institutional OA agreements are separate routes.
route.other_mandatory_costs: none for a standard manuscript with optional print colour declined

fee_evidence.note: Journal-specific instructions exclude submission charges; print-colour charges can be avoided by selecting greyscale.
Journal-specific publisher page explicitly says no APC charges apply under the subscription publishing model.

records.name: Journal of Comparative Economics: Political Economy
records.publisher: Oxford University Press for the Association for Comparative Economic Studies; publisher/title transition announced for 2027
records.scope_notes: Political economy broadly conceived: institutions, culture, political behaviour, development and economic history. Official OUP site advertises expanded title and new chapter for 2027, while already inviting submissions. Use transition-era instructions rather than assuming older Elsevier policies apply.

route.conditions: OUP explicitly states standard-licence publication costs nothing and excludes submission, page and colour charges. Immediate OA is optional. Recheck handling details during the 2026–2027 transition.
route.other_mandatory_costs: none; OUP explicitly excludes submission, page and colour charges

fee_evidence.note: OUP promises no-cost standard-licence publication with no submission, page or colour charges; page describes a new chapter in 2027.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in discovery; independent ranking review required.

publisher_transition.summary: OUP material for the renamed Journal of Comparative Economics: Political Economy is live and solicits submissions. Policies cover this announced route, not automatically every legacy handling route.

records.scope_notes: All fields of economics, including theoretical, empirical and policy work. Despite the title, pure statistics is explicitly excluded. Existing-data economic studies fit; statistical methods need an economic contribution.

route.other_mandatory_costs: unknown; submission cost needs explicit confirmation

route.conditions: Official instructions explicitly exclude submission fees. DOAJ records no APC, but its record was last fully reviewed in 2022; current venue-issued publication/page-cost exclusions were not located. Retain conservatively pending fee audit.

records.name: Health Economics
records.scope_notes: Original health-economic theory, empirical research and policy analysis, including health valuation, markets and health systems. Routine cost-effectiveness/costing/discrete-choice applications are generally excluded. Literature-review essays must synthesize questions relevant to economists; clinical-hypothesis systematic reviews are outside scope.

route.conditions: Guidelines offer standard copyright or optional paid OA, free online colour and optional paid print colour. They do not explicitly certify zero submission/all standard publication costs. Free Format concerns formatting flexibility, not price.
route.other_mandatory_costs: unknown; optional print colour, OA and paid services can be declined but remaining compulsory costs need verification

fee_evidence.note: Guidelines offer standard copyright alongside optional paid OA and print colour. No explicit blanket zero-fee statement located.

difficulty.basis: No difficulty ranking established in discovery; independent ranking review required.

notes: Primary-source discovery only; difficulty bands intentionally unknown and no acceptance/citation numbers inferred. Independent fee, ranking and skeptical review remain required.

Excluded fee trap: The Econometrics Journal has mandatory new-submission fees. Official RES announcement: https://res.org.uk/the-econometrics-journal-new-submission-fee/ ; live portal: https://www.editorialexpress.com/cgi-bin/e-editor/e-submit.cgi?dbase=ectj . Subscription publication does not negate submission costs.

Econometric Society annual report documents submission and publication-page charges: https://www.econometricsociety.org/publications/econometrica/2025/01/01/The-Econometric-Society-Annual-Reports-Report-of-the-Editors-20232024/file/ecta200773.pdf . Theoretical Economics and Quantitative Economics must not be labelled free merely because they are open access.

Nordic Journal of Health Economics explicitly excludes submission/publication fees, but the same current official page says it is not accepting submissions: https://journals.uio.no/index.php/NJHE/about/submissions . Excluded as an unavailable additional lead.
Economics and Business Letters is retained as fee-free but closed, with submission_status closed. It must not appear among currently available recommendations.

Additional no-submission-fee lead Economica: live LSE owner page https://www.lse.ac.uk/economics/about-us/economica explicitly excludes submission fees; standard-publication cost completeness was not finished in this bounded pass.

Judgment and Decision Making now has APCs and conditional funding/waiver routes, rather than unconditional diamond status: https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/judgment-and-decision-making/information/author-instructions/fees-and-pricing . Comparative Economic Research (Lodz) requires accepted-article fees from 2025-07-01: https://czasopisma.uni.lodz.pl/CER/publication_fees . Neither is represented as unconditionally free.
JCE has live OUP policy material for a 2027 publisher/title transition. No-cost assertions are tied to that advertised standard-licence route, not every legacy route or optional OA.
No venue was contacted, account created or research submitted. Documentary checks do not establish acceptance or scientific validity.
